_comment: Merged into the project package.json by scripts/add-sanity.sh. These are the packages the default scaffold deliberately does NOT carry. React (react, react-dom, react-is, styled-components, @astrojs/react) is already in the base scaffold and is a peer of both @sanity/astro and sanity, so it is not repeated here. NOTE the merge lets the PROJECT win on conflict, so this file cannot raise a base pin: the base floors (react/react-dom ^19.2.2, styled-components ^6.1.19) are set to satisfy sanity@6's peers and must move with any future Sanity major.
